name: hero-01
title: Hero 01
description: Hero: a lettered name over a city the visitor can reroll, one sentence, two actions and the install command.

files.content:
"use client" import { useState, type ReactNode } from "react" import { DicesIcon } from "lucide-react" import { Folly } from "@/serigraph/extras/folly" import { Lettering } from "@/serigraph/extras/lettering" import { seedOf, stream } from "@/serigraph/follies" import { cn } from "@/serigraph/lib/utils" import { Button, buttonVariants } from "@/serigraph/ui/button" import { CodeBlock, CodeBlockActions, CodeBlockContent, CodeBlockCopyButton, CodeBlockHeader, CodeBlockLine, CodeBlockTitle, } from "@/serigraph/ui/code-block" // A landing hero printed like the poster: the product's name lettered large, a line in the capitals above it, one // sentence, two actions and the install command, over a city of follies that runs the width of the section, its clouds // at the foot; nothing operated sits on the drawing. Reroll draws a new city from the next seed; the seeds walk a stream from the first, so every visitor // meets the same sequence. Every prop has a default (Serigraph's own landing), so the block is a finished page as it is. export const meta = { title: "Hero", description: "A lettered name over a city the visitor can reroll, one sentence, two actions and the install command.", } const ADJECTIVES = ["clear", "high", "late", "pale", "still", "warm", "wide"] const NOUNS = ["arcade", "dome", "meridian", "orbit", "stair", "terrace"] /** The seed after this one: a word pair drawn from a stream forked from it, never the same twice. */ export function nextSeed(seed: string) { const words = stream(seedOf(seed), "hero:reroll") let next = seed while (next === seed) next = `${words.pick(ADJECTIVES)}-${words.pick(NOUNS)}` return next } interface Action { label: string href: string } export interface Hero01Props { /** The product's name, lettered, and the page's heading. */ product?: string /** A line in the extended capitals above the name. */ kicker?: ReactNode /** One sentence on what it is. */ lede?: ReactNode primary?: Action secondary?: Action /** The command a visitor copies to install; omit to leave the code block out. */ install?: string /** The city's first seed; rerolls continue from it. */ seed?: string className?: string } export function Hero01({ product = "Serigraph", kicker = "A shadcn/ui kit · printed in five colourways", lede = "Flat, luminous spot colours laid one on another, one fine ink line, and seeded drawings of follies in the clouds.", primary = { label: "Browse components", href: "/docs" }, secondary = { label: "See it in use", href: "/meridian" }, install = "npx shadcn add @serigraph/serigraph", seed: first = "serigraph", className, }: Hero01Props) { const [seed, setSeed] = useState(first) return (

{kicker}

{product}

{lede}

{primary.label} {secondary.label}
{install && ( Terminal {install} )}
) } export default Hero01
